# MediaFlow Studio 1.2.1 — Up to 240 fps

## ✨ What's new

### 🎞️ Interpolation up to 240 fps
- **AI Enhance → Interpolation** now goes up to **120, 180 and 240 fps**, on top of 24 / 25 / 30 / 50 / 60.
- Perfect for **ultra-smooth slow motion**: interpolate a 30 fps clip to 240 fps, then slow it down 8× in your editor without stutter.
- Same pipeline as before: **RIFE** on your graphics card, 100% local, then hardware encoding (NVENC / Quick Sync / AMF) with the audio kept.
- Tip: high frame rates multiply the work (30 → 240 fps creates 8× more frames), so long clips take proportionally longer.

Already on 1.2.0 or earlier? The app offers this update automatically — click **Update**, then **Restart & Install**.
